title: Prove snapshot, close, settle and targeted chat reach hidden terminals
body:
Finish proving, and fix where wrong, that control-plane verbs aimed at a terminal work when that terminal is not on screen. Since card czysfd that is the normal case: every dispatched worker after the first is a back tab. Commit 13375ef proved part of the original card; this body is only what is left.

Hidden states:
1. A back tab in a stack.
2. A minimized window.
3. A terminal inside a minimized Project.
4. A terminal inside a Project that is itself a back tab on the desk.

ALREADY PROVEN (src/wm.rs, `hidden_tabs_fixture` and the tests after it). Reuse these; do not duplicate them:
- `send` with settle 0, states 1-2: `send_reaches_background_tab_and_minimized_terminal`.
- Chat BROADCAST, states 1-2: `chat_reaches_background_and_minimized_members`.
- Plain `snapshot` and chat, state 1: `stacked_back_tab_worker_keeps_claim_snapshot_and_chat`.
- The docs note already exists: docs/tab-targeting.md says hidden terminals are reachable by send, snapshot, chat and close.

STILL UNPROVEN:
- States 3 and 4 for every verb. `hidden_tabs_fixture` has a background Project tab (p2) but it is empty, and no Project is minimized. Extend the fixture rather than writing a second one.
- `send` with a nonzero --settle-ms in every state. Settle 0 says nothing about whether the settle deadline resolves on a terminal that is never drawn (see `wm::advance_settles`).
- `snapshot` with --attrs, --cursor and --tail (all states), and plain snapshot in states 2-4.
- TARGETED chat delivery (`--to tN`, the only way card workers hear posts, since they join with `Reception::TargetedOnly`), including Ready gating and idle-aware delivery, in every state. The existing chat test is a broadcast.
- `close` in every state. docs/tab-targeting.md claims it works; no test checks it.

ALSO CHECK: a worker stacked as a back tab may never have been drawn. What grid size does it have (snapshot reads that grid)? Does it match its stack window? What happens on its first draw (a resize)? Report what you find. Fix it only if the fix is small; otherwise file a follow-up card.

DONE WHEN:
- A table test over {the 4 hidden states} x {send with nonzero settle, snapshot with flags, targeted chat delivery, close} passes, driven headlessly like the existing hidden-tab tests (no GUI). Cells the tests above already cover can stay where they are.
- Any failing cell is fixed, or the card is blocked with the reason.
- If a fix changes behavior that docs/tab-targeting.md describes, correct that doc. No new doc file.
- Gate: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --target-dir target/agent; cargo test --target-dir target/agent.
